name: suggest_model_switch
description: Recommend switching the active model when the current capability tier is a poor fit: downgrade premium models for large straightforward tasks, or upgrade fast/balanced models for complex tasks. Works across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cursor via provider-neutral capability tiers (premium, balanced, fast).

current_model.description: Active model identifier as reported by the host.

provider.description: Model provider for the current session.

current_capability_tier.description: Resolved capability tier of the current model.

recommended_model_id.description: Concrete model slug for the host to apply, from the provider catalog.

task_summary.description: One-line description of what the user asked for.

task_class.description: straightforward for downgrade; complex for upgrade.

context_refs.description: URLs, file paths, PR numbers, Jira keys, etc.

estimated_input_tokens.description: Estimated tokens to ingest before any summarization.

context_band.description: Threshold band from the skill heuristics.

rationale.description: Brief explanation for the user: why the switch helps.

scoped_ingest_plan.description: How to fetch less context after switch.

auto_switch.description: If true, host may switch without prompt when user has opted in.

preserve_context.description: If true, host should carry user message and gate metadata into the new session.
